philo.title: Three pillars, one goal: you playing better.

1.title: Technique
1.body: Clean groundstrokes, bandeja, vibora, lob. Small adjustments with big impact — filmed, shown, corrected.

2.title: Tactics
2.body: Court positioning, building pressure, handling pressure. You learn to read what's happening — before it happens.

3.title: Mindset
3.body: Stay calm after mistakes. Communicate clearly with your partner. Play as a team, not as two players.

about.title: Florian Molleker.
about.subtitle: C-Trainer for Padel. Player. Learner.
about.p1: I've been playing padel for over two years — started like many: through a friend, a first lesson, and then couldn't stop. Today I'm at Playtomic Level 5 and teach what I've learned through many hours, mistakes, and coaches.
about.p2: As a certified C-Trainer, I work structured: every hour has a focus, each focus builds on the last. No random ball hitting — but a clear red thread that you follow to improve.
about.p3: What's important to me: Honesty about realism. I won't tell you you'll be a pro in four weeks. I'll show you what you can work on today — and in four weeks you'll see the difference yourself.
about.ctaBody: Write me on Instagram. I usually reply within hours.

services.title: Transparent. Per Person. No Package Tricks.
services.subtitle: All prices per person and hour. More players — cheaper per person. Court rental not included.

contact.title: Write me.
contact.subtitle: The quickest way to reach me is WhatsApp, Instagram, or the in-app chat on Playtomic. Just drop your level, preferred location and weekdays — I usually reply the same day.
